question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
metric1 AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT olist_customers.customer_unique_id) AS value
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    INNER JOIN olist_customers ON d.customer_id = olist_customers.customer_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ORDER BY value DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
metric2 AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        CAST(SUM(oi.price - oi.freight_value) AS DOUBLE) AS value
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ORDER BY value DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
metric3 AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS value
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ORDER BY value DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
metric4 AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS value
    FROM olist_order_reviews r
    INNER JOIN olist_order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON r.order_id = d.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ORDER BY value DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement, seller_id, value FROM metric1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest profit', seller_id, ROUND(value, 2) FROM metric2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct orders', seller_id, value FROM metric3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, value FROM metric4;
